contract.review_scope: Complete captured redacted body; projected expressions/aliases, joins, filters, quantity/status selection, null behavior, grouping and ordering. Opaque literals and external callers remain qualified.
contract.purpose: Prepare bounded GS1 application-identifier detail fields for a shipping container.
inputs_defaults: Captured declaration (literal placeholders are not executable values): CREATE PROCEDURE LBL_GS1AILabelDetail ( @INTERNAL_CONTAINER_NUM numeric(9)) AS
null_and_invalid_input_behavior: Item/company comparison normalizes company with opaque replacements, but lot comparison uses <> so NULL does not compare unequal. Cursor quantity is the current/last fetched group's quantity, not an additional grand total. The fallback tests @@CURSOR_ROWS < 1 and sets zero quantity/coded item; it also admits negative cursor-count reporting, so this branch alone does not prove zero qualifying rows. Cursor kind, defaults and runtime count behavior are not established. Missing grouped assignments can leave variables NULL; item and serial fallbacks use ISNULL. Duplicate serial rows, including an active/retained duplicate, still count because UNION ALL preserves them. Expiry sentinel comparison can involve implicit datetime conversion; exact literal meaning not established. Lot expiration lookup matches lot, item and NULL-normalized company without a warehouse predicate. Multiple matching lots, including across warehouses, can assign @expdate without ORDER BY; no deterministic expiry choice is established.
output_shape: One final row: ITEM, ITEM_CROSS_REFERENCE, QUANTITY, LOT, EXPIRATION_DATE, SERIAL_NUMBER, AI_ITEM, AI_XREF, AI_QTY, AI_LOT, AI_EXP, AI_SN, AI_LP. Earlier SELECTs assign variables or feed a local cursor and do not emit row sets.

ordered_branches.explanation: First try exactly one requested container with non-NULL container ID/item, setting quantity to1 and unit to CONTAINER_TYPE. Otherwise cursor-group item/company/lot over the requested container and up to three descendant levels, summing each group; compare successive groups for differing item/company or lot and retain coded errors in variables. This is bounded nesting, not arbitrary recursion. Resolve sequence1 unit with ITMfn_RtrvUnitOfMeasure, then grouped GTIN item metadata and item cross-reference; duplicate cross-reference rows produce a coded fallback. Read lot expiry and UNION ALL active/retained serial rows for the same bounded container tree; more than one serial row produces a coded fallback. Apply one opaque expiry sentinel and emit fields; AI_QTY depends on cross-reference first character and AI_EXP on NULL expiry.
